tools.name: resource_flow_start
tools.description: Create a server-owned Flow from a goal-oriented task.

tools.name: resource_flow_status
tools.description: Read a compact recovery summary of the current Flow without replaying full candidates, resolutions, digests, or execution routes.

tools.name: resource_flow_list
tools.description: List recent flows ordered by most recently updated to discover or recover flow state after context loss.

tools.name: resource_search
tools.description: Search one or more sources and return compact review candidates. Extend mode binds to the current server-owned ResultSet; clients do not carry ResultSet/task versions.

tools.name: resource_presentation_save
tools.description: Persist the exact ordered resources actually displayed from the current ResultSet; clients submit only displayed resource IDs.

tools.name: resource_selection_save
tools.description: Save explicit user choices by positions from the current server-owned Presentation; clients do not carry Presentation versions.

tools.name: resource_download_prepare
tools.description: Create an expiring Plan from the current Selection and inspected Representations. Selection/Presentation bindings are resolved server-side.

tools.name: resource_download_start
tools.description: Consume a confirmed Plan after revalidating the current Selection, Representation, and exact Provider route, then create a Job.

tools.name: resource_job_status
tools.description: Read compact Job status, progress, ready asset handles, and failure summaries without execution-route internals.

tools.name: resource_job_cancel
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued or running Job.

tools.name: resource_archive
tools.description: Archive a ready Asset from a succeeded Job without accepting a local path.

tools.name: resource_library_search
tools.description: Search archived Assets through bounded metadata filters and an opaque cursor.

tools.name: resource_browse_creator
tools.description: Browse a creator content list using a platform-native creator_id, and return compact candidates. Use resource.creator_id from Inspect when available.

tools.name: resource_inspect
tools.description: Inspect one existing Flow resource and expose decision-relevant availability/representation facts without internal evidence fingerprints or inspector machinery.
